label: Vegetarian
description: Avoids meat, poultry, fish and seafood (eggs and dairy are fine).

label: Vegan
description: Avoids all animal-derived foods: meat, fish, seafood, eggs, dairy and honey.

label: Halal-friendly
description: Screens out pork, alcohol, gelatin and non-halal animals. Not a halal certification.

label: Kosher-style
description: Screens out pork, shellfish/crustaceans/molluscs, eel, catfish, shark and other fish without fins and scales, and non-kosher animals. Not a kosher certification.

label: Gluten-free
description: Screens out wheat, barley, rye, spelt and related grains, plus oats: regular oats are usually cross-contaminated with wheat, so only oats labelled gluten-free are safe.

label: Lactose-free
description: Screens out milk, cream, yogurt, kefir, whey, butter and soft/fresh cheeses. Aged hard cheeses (Parmesan, Emmental, Gruyere, aged Gouda/Cheddar) are naturally below 0.1 g lactose/100 g and are allowed.

label: Nut-free
description: Screens out tree nuts (almond, hazelnut, walnut, cashew, pecan, Brazil, pistachio, macadamia, pine nuts, chestnuts) and peanuts. Coconut, nutmeg, butternut squash and water chestnuts are allowed.

label: Low-sodium aware
description: Screens out salty processed ingredients and foods with more than 600 mg sodium per 100 g.
